acceptanceCriteria: Interrupting corvint-tasks gate run (SIGINT/SIGTERM, supervisor timeout) is reproduced and its retained output observed: whether partial gate stdout/stderr and the attempt record survive is recorded as evidence.
If partial output is lost, gate run retains a bounded transcript and an interrupted outcome on interruption, with a test proving it.
Spec requirement, test and build-log entry are recorded, or the observation closes the ticket with evidence that retention already works.
body: Decision 0544 closes CORE-FINISH-INTERRUPTED-TRANSCRIPT-PRESERVATION-1 as obsolete (Core managed finish no longer runs gates after the ADR-0227 cutover). The successor question for Corvint Tasks is NOT_OBSERVED: does corvint-tasks gate run retain the gate transcript and an interrupted outcome when the run is interrupted?
title: Tasks gate run: observe and retain the gate transcript on interruption (successor to CORE-FINISH-INTERRUPTED-TRANSCRIPT-PRESERVATION-1)
